name: hitesh-skills
description: Claude Code skills for learning-by-simulation workflows and related tools.

plugins.name: tycoon-sim
plugins.description: Learn how complex processes work via RollerCoaster Tycoon-style interactive simulations, with an adversarial accuracy-review phase to keep them hallucination-free.

plugins.name: depth-dial
plugins.description: One topic at five zoom levels on one page: every claim expands one level deeper in place, so the reader controls depth per-concept.

plugins.name: anatomy
plugins.description: Learn a system's structure via an interactive exploded-view diagram: click components for role, interfaces, design rationale, and failure propagation.

plugins.name: teach-back
plugins.description: Retention through retrieval practice: explain the topic in your own words, get graded against a verified knowledge base, get re-taught only your gaps.

plugins.name: knob-lab
plugins.description: Causal intuition via an interactive sandbox: sliders for the real governing parameters, live charts, sourced equations, honest regime warnings.

plugins.name: paper-walkthrough
plugins.description: Turn a dense paper into a verified interactive companion: notation glossary, figures re-explained, two-depth sections, design decisions with their why.

plugins.name: prereq-map
plugins.description: Find where your knowledge actually ends: prerequisite graph, short calibration diagnostic, shortest learning path routed to the right learning skill.
